name: Satisfaction With Life Scale
time_window_text: Below are five statements that you may agree or disagree with. Please indicate your agreement with each item.

items.text: In most ways my life is close to my ideal.
The conditions of my life are excellent.
I am satisfied with my life.
So far I have gotten the important things I want in life.
If I could live my life over, I would change almost nothing.

band_descriptions.extremely_dissatisfied: Your responses suggest you are extremely dissatisfied with your life. This is worth paying attention to, as these feelings highlight a significant need for change or support.
band_descriptions.dissatisfied: Your responses indicate you are dissatisfied with your life overall. Many people find it helpful to monitor this and identify specific areas they would like to improve.
band_descriptions.slightly_dissatisfied: Your responses suggest you are slightly dissatisfied with your life. Most people experience periods of dissatisfaction, and exploring these feelings can be a helpful first step.
band_descriptions.neutral: Your responses indicate a neutral level of life satisfaction. Your responses fall within the typical range for individuals experiencing a mix of fulfilling and challenging life areas.
band_descriptions.slightly_satisfied: Your responses suggest you are slightly satisfied with your life. Most people experience this, and your responses fall within the typical, healthy range.
band_descriptions.satisfied: Your responses indicate you are satisfied with your life. This suggests you have strong resources and are finding fulfilment in most of your daily experiences.
band_descriptions.extremely_satisfied: Your responses suggest you are extremely satisfied with your life. This suggests you have strong resources in this area and feel highly fulfilled.
